[[C. B. Bhave]] (Chairman){{cite news |title=Max Bupa appoints Krishnan Ramachandran as MD, CEO |url=https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/business/india-business/max-bupa-appoints-krishnan-ramachandran-as-md-ceo/articleshow/75553507.cms |publisher=Times of India |date=5 May 2020}} | products = | brands = | services = [[Health insurance]] | parent = [[Bupa]] (55%) | subsidiaries = | website = nivabupa.com }} '''Niva Bupa Health Insurance Company Limited''' ('''Niva Bupa''') is an Indian [[health insurance]] company, founded in 2008 and headquartered in [[New Delhi]]. It is a subsidiary of UK-based health insurance and healthcare company [[Bupa]]. The company is regulated by the [[Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority of India]] (IRDAI).{{cite news |last1=Bhasin |first1=Tinesh |title=Max India sells its stake in Max Bupa but policyholders needn't worry |url=https://www.livemint.com/insurance/news/max-india-sells-its-stake-in-max-bupa-but-policyholders-needn-t-worry-11575366581558.html |publisher=[[Livemint]] |date=3 December 2019}} == History == The company was founded as Max Bupa Health Insurance in 2008 as a 74:26 joint venture between [[Max Group|Max India]] and [[Bupa]], with operations starting in 2010.{{cite news |title=Max Bupa health cover enters India |url=https://www.indiatoday.in/business/story/max-bupa-health-cover-enters-india-73096-2010-04-30 |publisher=[[India Today]] |date=30 April 2010}}{{cite news |title=Max launches Bupa Health Insurance in India |url=https://www.adgully.com/max-launches-bupa-health-insurance-in-india-42982.html |publisher=Adgully |date=8 May 2010}} It distributed its policies through its agents and [[bancassurance]] partners.{{cite news |last1=Kurian |first1=Boby |last2=Shetty |first2=Mayur |title=True North set to control Max Bupa |url=https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/business/india-business/true-north-set-to-control-max-bupa/articleshow/68160391.cms |work=[[The Times of India]] |date=26 February 2019}}{{cite news |last1=Srivats |first1=KR |title=Max Bupa and Indian Bank ink bancassurance tie-up to offer health insurance solutions |url=https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/money-and-banking/max-bupa-and-indian-bank-ink-bancassurance-tie-up-to-offer-health-insurance-solutions/article29475517.ece |publisher=[[The Hindu Business Line]] |date=21 September 2019}}{{cite news |title=IDBI Bank ties up with Max Bupa |url=https://www.zeebiz.com/personal-finance/news-health-insurance-idbi-max-bupa-suvidha-health-plus-idbi-max-bupa-loan-secure-medical-insurance-101872 |publisher=[[Zee Business]] |date=11 June 2019}} In 2015, Bupa increased its stake in the company to 49%, after acquiring a 23% stake from Max India for {{INRConvert|191|c|mode=historical|year=2015}}.{{cite news |title=Bupa to acquire additional 23% stake in Max Bupa |url=https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/money-and-banking/bupa-to-pay-191-cr-raise-max-bupa-stake-to-49/article64346782.ece |access-date=25 March 2026 |work=BusinessLine |date=23 November 2015 |language=en}} In February 2019, Max India's entire 51% stake was acquired by Fettle Tone LLP, an affiliate of Indian private equity firm True North, for {{INRConvert|510|c|mode=historical|year=2019}}.{{cite news |title=Max India exits health insurance biz, divests stake in Max Bupa for Rs 510 cr |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/markets/stocks/news/max-india-exits-health-insurance-biz-divests-stake-in-max-bupa-for-rs-510-cr/articleshow/68173878.cms |access-date=25 March 2026 |work=The Economic Times |date=26 February 2019}}{{cite news |title=IRDAI nod for Max stake sale in venture with Bupa |url=https://www.thehindu.com/business/irdai-nod-for-max-stake-sale-in-venture-with-bupa/article30152481.ece |work=[[The Hindu]] |date=3 December 2019}} In 2023, True North announced that it would sell a 20% stake in the company to Bupa for {{INRconvert|2700|c}}, making Bupa the majority shareholder at 63%.{{cite news |last1=Chatterjee |first1=Dev |title=True North sells 20% stake in Niva Bupa to Bupa for Rs 2,700 crore |url=https://www.business-standard.com/companies/news/true-north-sells-20-stake-in-niva-bupa-to-bupa-for-rs-2-700-crore-123092901261_1.html |access-date=25 March 2026 |work=Business Standard |date=29 September 2023}}{{cite news |title=India's True North to sell $325 mln stake in Niva Bupa Insurance |url=https://www.reuters.com/markets/deals/indias-true-north-sell-325-mln-stake-niva-bupa-insurance-2023-09-29/ |access-date=25 March 2026 |work=Reuters |date=29 September 2023}} In November 2024, Niva Bupa went public with an [[initial public offering]] and listed on the NSE and BSE,{{cite news |last1=Sen |first1=Meghna |title=Niva Bupa IPO: Price band set at ₹70-74 a share for ₹2,200-crore issue |url=https://www.cnbctv18.com/market/niva-bupa-ipo-price-band-set-gmp-rs-2200-crore-issue-19503444.htm |access-date=25 March 2026 |work=CNBC TV18 |date=4 November 2024 |language=en}} with Bupa continuing as the sole [[Corporate promoter|promoter]] after the IPO with an ownership of over 55%.{{cite news |last1=Varier |first1=Aathira |title=UK-based Bupa likely to increase stake in Niva Bupa Health Insurance |url=https://www.business-standard.com/companies/news/after-hike-in-fdi-limit-bupa-may-raise-stake-in-niva-bupa-health-insurance-125020900198_1.html |access-date=25 March 2026 |work=Business Standard |date=10 February 2025}} == Violations == In 2016, the IRDAI imposed a penalty of {{INR}}20 lakh on the company for four violations, one of which pertained to timelines for settling claims.{{Cite news |date=2016-05-02 |title=Rs.20 lakh IRDA penalty on Max Bupa Health Insurance |url=https://www.thehindu.com/news/cities/Hyderabad/rs20-lakh-irda-penalty-on-max-bupa-health-insurance/article8549564.ece |access-date=2024-11-08 |work=The Hindu |language=en-IN |issn=0971-751X}} == extract: Niva Bupa Health Insurance Company Limited (Niva Bupa) is an Indian health insurance company, founded in 2008 and headquartered in New Delhi. It is a subsidiary of UK-based health insurance and healthcare company Bupa. The company is regulated by the Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority of India (IRDAI).
